body:
IMPORTANT FLAG (report-not-apply, your call needed) -- pass_216.

Finished reading FORGE_EDGE_III.md in full. Its central bet: magnitude of the next move is ~8x more predictable than direction (published IC ~0.25 vs ~0.03), and the whole organism/DNA/adaptive-risk redesign is built on that premise. The document even names its own proof-or-disproof number for OUR data: if magnitude IC comes back under 0.10 on real data, 'the strongest published regularity does not hold here.'

I already ran that exact test this session (Step 3.4, on the real 50k-row historical export, known-answer-tested, effective-n-corrected for autocorrelation, forward-looking columns only -- caught and fixed a same-bar-vs-forward bug in my own first attempt before trusting the result). Real answer: magnitude IC = 0.0079. That's about 1/13th of the document's own disproof threshold and 1/32nd of its headline expectation. Directional IC also came back near zero (0.0134). On this instrument, magnitude is NOT meaningfully more predictable than direction -- the opposite of the document's central premise.

Per the standing rule, I'm reporting this, not unilaterally halting the FORGE_EDGE_III sequence or the redesign. The document separately treats the organism 'lean' test (does price lean away from 50/50 after certain patterns) as the one still-genuinely-untested, separable question -- so I'm continuing to Step 4 (organism identification + lean test) rather than idling, since that's next in the operative directive's own sequence and doesn't depend on the magnitude claim being true. But the foundational premise the whole redesign leans on is now measured false on our own data, and that deserves your eyes before more is built on it.

Full detail: forge_ledger.json pass_213 (the measurement) and pass_216 (this cross-reference), both synced. step3_magnitude_ic_result.json has the raw numbers. Live calibration run (build SLS(153), WARRANT#212 fix) continues in the background unaffected -- r1 Strong Bull just finished with an honest 'no edge found, overfit rejected' result, now on r2. Nothing paused.
